body.intent: Rhiza's own .rhiza/workflows/ship-change.toml, which shadows the builtin, gets the pre-handoff checklist text (run rhiza ship generate and rhiza render, a Checks: block with exit codes) in its ci-fix, gate-fix, gate-fix-merge, conflict-fix and conflict-fix-landed prompts, so this repo's own fixers follow it as the builtin's do.
